parts.text:

parts.text:
The student decides that a more useful result is possible if the length is measured to the
centre of mass of the pendulum bob.
The pendulum bob is a small metal ball. The student has a 30 cm ruler and two
rectangular blocks of wood that are about 10 cm long.
Suggest how the student can use this equipment to measure accurately the diameter of
the pendulum bob. You may draw a diagram.
